Perfect! Both typecheck and tests pass. 

## Summary

I fixed the missing post excerpts bug by adding the `excerpt` field to the `PostResource.toArray()` method in `/private/tmp/aog-worktrees/run-resource-drops-excerpt-claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-shipped-3/app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts` (line 26). The resource interface declared the field and all three affected pages (Index, Show, Edit) expected it, but the transformation layer was omitting it from the returned data. Now post excerpts will display correctly on the post list cards, the individual post detail page, and the edit form will be pre-filled as expected.
